name: Erythromycin Propionate

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Mauritius and 2 other countries, first in 1982 — for liver harm

summary: Erythromycin Propionate was removed from the market in Mauritius and two other countries starting in 1982 because it caused liver harm [3]. A small computer model, not tests on humans, gave the drug a high risk score of 85 for liver problems [M]. The same computer model estimated a low risk score of 18 for heart issues, also without testing on people [M].
